author: C4ff
quote: Most anticipated game and still bad. We waited 13 years for a game that doesn’t is GTA. The game looks good but that’s it. Low fps, many bugs, trying to be as family friendly as possible without completely destroying it. Grand theft auto but you can’t make grand theft and can’t steal automobiles. All what makes GTA great, the chaos, the edginess, everything feels gone for a “live simulator” after all I can say it’s not worth any money and it’s not worth to be called GTA. When GTA Online comes, we will see… but right now? Don’t buy it.
